BiblicalUsage: Eladah is an Israelite. In 1 Chronicles 7:20, the text says "and Eladah his son." The life behind the name is told on the Eladah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eladah matters because God knows His people by name, and Eladah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
